senses.gloss: 1. रि रि, i. 6, रिय, Par. To go.
2. रि रि, ii. 5, v. r. for ऋ, ii. 5, To hurt.

1. री री, ii. 9, रिणा, रिणी. Par.
 1. To go.
 2. To howl.
 3. To hart.

2. री री, i. 4, Ātm. To distil, to ooze, to drop.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To drop after, to follow dropping, Chr. 291, 3 = Rigv. i. 85, 3.
 --Cf. Goth. and A.S. rinnan (based on ii. 5).
